name: click-to-edit-ui
description: Point at web UI components by Alt-clicking them in the browser, then request edits by number instead of describing elements in words

interface.shortDescription: Point at UI elements and edit them by number.
interface.longDescription: Alt-click rendered UI elements in Chrome, then ask Codex to edit the numbered selections and verify the result in the live page.
defaultPrompt: Set up the click probe for this UI.
Read my selected elements and edit them.
Re-arm the probe after reloading the page.
